extensions.name: Adjustments Pro
extensions.description: Photoshop's core adjustments: Levels, Curves, Exposure, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Black & White, Photo Filter, Gradient Map, Shadows/Highlights, Equalize, plus Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Background Remover
extensions.description: Cut subjects out of their background in a dedicated tab: AI subject detection (U²-Net), a magic wand, erase/restore brushes and edge clean-up. Also adds Layer ▸ Remove Background and Select ▸ Subject.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Basic Filters
extensions.description: Gaussian & Box Blur, Unsharp Mask, Sharpen, Add Noise, Mosaic, plus Brightness/Contrast, Posterize and Threshold adjustments.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Creative Filters
extensions.description: Photoshop's creative filter menu: Motion & Radial Blur, Twirl, Pinch, Spherize, Ripple, Wave, Polar Coordinates, Median, Dust & Scratches, Color Halftone, Crystallize, Clouds, Vignette, Emboss, Find Edges, Oil Paint, Solarize, Diffuse, High Pass, Minimum/Maximum and Offset.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Layer Effects
extensions.description: Photoshop-style layer styles — Drop Shadow, Outer Glow, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Stroke, Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay and Bevel & Emboss — each created on its own layer with a live preview (Layer ▸ Layer Style).
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Web Images Extractor
extensions.description: A built-in web browser in its own tab. Browse any page, collect every image it shows (lazy-loaded ones too), then add them to your Lumen project as layers, open them as documents or save them.
extensions.author: Lumen
